name: lock-free-ring-buffers
description: Use this skill when the user says 'lock-free', 'ring buffer', 'LMAX Disruptor', 'SPSC/MPMC queue', 'false sharing', 'mechanical sympathy'. Explains lock-free inter-thread communication with ring buffers and cache-aware design. Do NOT use for: kernel-bypass networking (use niche/hft/kernel-bypass-dpdk) or general concurrency primitives.
